stance_rationale: PD29 has useful realized artifacts, but it is not judge-ready: all three weighting variants fail 4-axis strict improvement versus the stated S4 baseline, baseline/DSR/Harvey checks are deferred or hard-coded, turnover is not round-trip gated, and SOFT violates the 20% single-name cap. The draft still reads as a plan rather than a reconciled final package after realized results.

critical_concerns.description: Realized PD29 results fail every strict improvement axis versus the stated S4 v2 baseline: EW/LIN/SOFT Sharpe 0.9898/1.0034/1.0074 versus 1.81, CAGR 16.49/16.72/16.88% versus 19.99%, MDD -27.56/-25.01/-22.83% versus -12.63%, and CVaR about -8.8% versus -5.01%. A draft package that does not explicitly convert this into a reject/retain-baseline conclusion is not decision-grade.

Baseline comparison is hard-coded as documented S4 v2 metrics, not recomputed same-period, same-cost, same-DSR over the PD29 2001-08 to 2026-03 realized window. This is exactly the unfair-baseline pattern RF-F4 is meant to catch.

Composite-level DSR and Harvey 5-spec regressions for EW/LIN/SOFT net returns are absent and explicitly deferred. Risk-package alpha/top20 5-spec evidence is not a substitute for Forge-level composite returns with the same DSR penalty applied to candidate and baseline.

Turnover gate is likely understated because run_all_pd29.R annualizes monthly turnover with ×12 but does not apply the round-trip ×2 required by the Forge checklist. Reported annual TO 333%, 432%, and 385.8% become about 666%, 864%, and 771.6% round-trip, so all three variants breach the 600% hard turnover gate.

SOFT single-name cap enforcement is broken: top20_holdings_3weighting.csv has max w_SOFT_capped 0.4386619 sleeve-internal, which becomes 24.13% at 55% KR equity weight, exceeding the hard 20% per-name cap. The cap routine is non-iterative and redistributes excess back above the cap.

Lockbox governance is not satisfied: the equity curve has no visible lockbox marker, no pre-LB/lockbox/combined decomposition, and no frozen extension evidence, while PD29 consumes alpha through 2026-04. A continuous post-2024 line alone does not prove sealed lockbox handling.

The requested qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is absent. PD29 has a 298-date holdings schedule, but stage_artifacts/weights.csv is a separate 155-date static sleeve schedule, so the official schedule path remains ambiguous for hook verification.

Inherited alpha PIT disputes remain live: prior alpha critic stance was REJECT over PIT-C13/C14 handling, and PD29 directly blends z_1715 and z_NEW without resolving that upstream dispute inside the Forge package.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function audit for the inherited PD27, PD24, and PD28 parquet inputs passes: all three start/end md5 hashes match.
PD29 is not a single-snapshot 22-year replay: top20_holdings_3weighting.csv contains 298 sig_dates, and realized period return files cover 296 months from 2001-08 to 2026-03.
Required chart artifacts are present under backtest_result_pd29/output, including equity_curve_3weighting.png, annual_returns_3weighting.png, and oos_zoom_chart_3weighting.png.
The supplied covariance.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001 is PSD with condition number about 8.81, satisfying the post-shrink cond <= 100 check for that artifact.
unresolved_disputes: Whether documented S4 v2 metrics can be used at all without same-period same-cost recomputation.
Whether the 600% hard turnover gate is one-way or round-trip; the Forge role prompt requires round-trip treatment.
Whether PD29 should be finalized as an explicit reject/retain-S4 comparison report rather than an admission candidate.
Whether post-2024 alpha use is allowed without frozen lockbox extension and marker evidence.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that PD29 can be judge-ready while using documented baseline metrics, deferred DSR/5-spec tests, one-way turnover gating, and a non-iterative cap routine even though realized outputs fail all 4 strict axes versus S4.
rebuttal_required: Recompute S4 v2 baseline on the exact PD29 2001-08 to 2026-03 window with identical cost and DSR penalty.
Run composite-level CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions for EW/LIN/SOFT and same-period baseline.
Compute and apply DSR with declared candidates_tried_total to both candidates and baseline.
Fix SOFT cap redistribution iteratively and regenerate metrics if any holdings change.
Report turnover as round-trip annualized and re-evaluate the 600% hard gate.
Add lockbox marker, frozen-extension evidence, and pre-LB/lockbox/combined reporting.
rationalization_red_flags: TC drag annual 4-17bps across candidates (negligible vs SR delta)
CVaR cap infeasible / structural to KR equity baseline

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Artifact-level checks show PD29 is a valid comparison run but not an approval package. The realized metrics and hard-constraint failures dominate the narrative claims.
